'''Celegians''' were a nonhumanoid [[Species/Legends|species]] from [[Celegia]], a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] with raging seas located in the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]]. Celegians were relatively isolationist as a species, but had good relations with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

{{Species-stub}}

==Biology and appearance==
Celegians appeared to many [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoids]] as "floating [[Brain/Legends|brains]]." Very intelligent, they had a natural form of [[Telekinesis/Legends|telekinesis]] that functioned like a [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlift]]. They breathed [[cyanogen]], a gas poisonous to [[Human/Legends|Humans]]. Conversely, [[Oxygen/Legends|oxygen]] was lethal to them, necessitating atmospheric [[Transport/Legends|transport]] [[Celegian life support chamber|chambers]] offworld.

The Celegians were greatly known for their massive intellect and wisdom. Their race evolved from ocean-dwelling invertebrates to the ancestors that eventually lived on land in Celegia. To move their jellyfish-like bodies, the Celegians created a form of locomotion similar to a repulsorlift generator. Their soft fleshy bodies, great tentacles, and dependence upon life-support chambers made the Celegians look as though they were always swimming or floating. Celegians communicated using a form of [[Telepathy/Legends|telepathy]], and had no written or spoken [[Language/Legends|language]].

==Celegians in the galaxy==
Celegians tended to be explorers, and were often found in the company of other species with the same interests. Those Celegians that could be encountered away from their homeworld were usually scouts or diplomats, although a rare few were trained in the ways of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] by the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]]. One of the most notable Celegians was [[Ooroo/Legends|Ooroo]], a [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] during the [[Great Hyperspace War/Legends|Great Hyperspace War]].
